_about: Public-domain Chandler Robbins (1810-1882), Emerson's successor as minister of the Second Church, Boston, for the Word Hoard: his sermons and discourses (1844-1875), his History of the Second Church, or Old North (1852), Portrait of a Christian (1858), and memorial discourses. Not to be confused with the earlier Chandler Robbins (1738-1799) of Plymouth. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 93 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

crobbins-two-sermons-1844: Two sermons, delivered before the Second Church and Society, Sunday, March 10, 1844, on the occasion of taking down their ancient place of worship (Boston : Printed by Isaac R. Butts, 1844)
crobbins-corner-stone: Address delivered at the laying of the corner-stone of the Second Church on Thursday morning, May 30, 1844 (Boston : I.R. Butts, 1844)
crobbins-proprietors-1845: A sermon delivered before the proprietors of the Second Church : Wednesday, September 17, 1845, at the dedication of their new house of worship (Boston : Printed by Isaac R. Butts, 1845)
crobbins-bridge-installation: A sermon preached at the installation of Rev. A. M. Bridge : as colleague pastor of the First Congregational Church and Society in Bernardston, Mass. Feb. 18, 1846 (Crosby, Nichols, and Co., 1846)
crobbins-frothingham-wolcott: A sermon preached after the death of Mrs. Eliza Frothingham and Mrs. Cornelia F. Wolcott, mother and daughter : the latter of whom died June 1, and the former June 5, 1850 (Printed by John Wilson, 1850)
crobbins-second-church-history: A history of the Second Church, or Old North, in Boston : to which is added a History of the New Brick Church (Boston : Published by a committee of the Society, 1852)
crobbins-noah-lincoln: A sermon preached after the funeral of Noah Lincoln : who died in Boston, July 31, 1856, aged eighty-four (Boston : Printed by John Wilson and Son, 1856)
crobbins-lunt: A discourse in commemoration of Rev. William Parsons Lunt, D.D. : delivered at Quincy, Mass., on Sunday, June 7, 1857 (Boston : Little, Brown and Company, 1857)
crobbins-portrait-christian: Portrait of a Christian, drawn from life: a memoir of Maria Elizabeth Clapp (Boston, Printed for the Sunday-School Society, 1858)
crobbins-central-power: The central power of the gospel : a sermon preached at the installation of Rev. Grindall Reynolds, as pastor of the First Church in Concord, Mass., July 8, 1858 (John Wilson and Son, 1858)
crobbins-dedication-1875: A sermon preached at the dedication of the Second Church : Boylston Street, November 4th, 1874 (Boston : Press of Gribben & Co., 1875)

_excluded.crobbins-compiled: hymn books and the Liturgy he compiled, Our Pastors' Offering (a compilation), the Appleton memoir, and Massachusetts Historical Society proceedings
_excluded.crobbins-elder: works of Chandler Robbins (1738-1799) of Plymouth, a different man
